name: expense_key
description: sha256 of (fiscal year, quarter, member name, constituency) as published. Primary key.

name: candidates
description: person_ids that matched equally well (ambiguous rows only).

name: match_method
description: exact_name_term (name matches and a term overlaps the quarter) | exact_name_term_party (namesakes settled by the caucus).

name: constituency
description: As published. Context only, never a join key.

name: fiscal_year
description: Federal fiscal year of the report, e.g. '2022-23' (April to March).

name: source_url
description: The ourcommons.ca CSV the row was read from.

name: run_id
description: Curate run that last wrote this row.
